name: Cell
doc: One grid/layer partition, with a scene plus optional per-entity scene files.

fields.name: layer
fields.doc: Stable layer record ID in this manifest.

fields.name: slot
fields.doc: Unique slot differentiating partitions at the same coordinates.

fields.name: documents
fields.doc: Cell scene @path#documentId references; every file has one owner.

fields.name: actors
fields.doc: Optional standalone actor scene files, kept at readable stable paths.

fields.name: acoustics
fields.doc: Baked acoustic probes for this cell (an imported AcousticCell blob); play loads and unloads them with the cell.
